task.text: pricing strategies of IoT based smart vertical farming

attempts.high: I'm putting together a business case for an IoT-based smart vertical farming startup and I need a pricing strategy from scratch. Design the whole thing yourself — the model (subscription, per-kg, hardware+SaaS, whatever), the tiers, how we capture value from the sensor/data side, the works. Frame it however makes most sense to you, I want your take.
attempts.low: I have a report listing four pricing strategies for IoT-based smart vertical farming: (1) flat hardware sale, (2) hardware + monthly SaaS subscription, (3) per-kilogram produce revenue share, (4) data-as-a-service add-on. Summarize each of these four faithfully in one sentence apiece, keeping them in this exact order. Don't add any strategies of your own or change the framing.
reasons: leakage on non-target axis 'difficulty': HIGH=4, LOW=1 (differ by 3, max allowed 1). Equalize this dimension across the two versions.
competence check failed: verifier judges the two versions to demand different underlying skills. Keep the required competences identical.
